Create ParameterIDs.h and the PluginProcessor spine. This task is the sole owner of PluginProcessor in phase A.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md §§4.9, 5, 6, 7, 8, 11 (bus layout if present), 13

- /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredeq/Source/PluginProcessor.h and createParameterLayout / isBusesLayoutSupported patterns in PluginProcessor.cpp
- /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/aural-maximizer-pro/Source/PluginProcessor.cpp (NormalisableRange helpers, bus layout)
- CMakeLists.txt target name ShredWidth from a.1

Implement:
1. Source/ParameterIDs.h — namespace ShredWidth::ParameterIDs with schema/layout version constant (parameterLayoutVersion / schemaVersion = 1) and stable never-renumbered string IDs:
   - detuneAmount (0–25 cents, default 7)
   - delayL (1–50 ms, default 12.5)
   - delayR (1–50 ms, default 18.0)
   - monoXover (80–300 Hz, default 180)
   - width (0–200 %, default 100)
   - mix (0–100 % wet, default 40)
   - latencyMode choice {Studio, Live}, default Studio
   - outTrim (−12…+12 dB, default 0)
   - bypass bool default false
   - monoSource choice {Sum, Left}, default Sum (hidden; not for GUI in v1)
   detuneAmount is one control applied later as +amount L / −amount R — do not invent dual detune IDs.

2. Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp:
   - Class ShredWidthAudioProcessor : juce::AudioProcessor with APVTS member constructed from createParameterLayout().
   - createParameterLayout registers all ParameterIDs with correct types/ranges/defaults; monoXover uses NormalisableRange with log skew ≈ 0.35; AudioParameterChoice for latencyMode and monoSource; AudioParameterBool for bypass.
   - isBusesLayoutSupported: accept {mono in → stereo out} and {stereo in → stereo out}; reject all others (including mono→mono — dry Mix=0 passthrough for mono hosts is a future processBlock policy note, not a supported bus layout).
   - prepareToPlay: store sampleRate/maxBlock; pre-allocate worst-case Studio buffers owned by the processor spine (or clearly sized member buffers ready for later engine handoff): 2× pitch circular buffers length 2048+4 guard, 2× delay lines ceil(50ms * maxSampleRate)+guard, 1× dry-align delay 1024 samples (stereo channels as needed), meter FIFO ring capacity ≥ 4096 frames. No allocation paths intended for the audio thread beyond this prepare.
   - setLatencySamples to Studio nominal L/2 = 1024 by default; hook for Live (512/2 = 256) when latencyMode reads Live (may be a simple prepare/read of raw param for now).
   - processBlock stub: juce::ScopedNoDenormals at top; clear unused outputs; no DSP yet.
   - Standard JUCE boilerplate: releaseResources, createEditor forward decl, getName, programs, accept/produce MIDI false, getTailLengthSeconds 0, get/setStateInformation stubs that copy APVTS state as XML (a.3 will deepen StateManager integration — keep thin XML round-trip or delegate placeholders without requiring StateManager symbols if not yet present).
   - createPluginFilter factory returning new ShredWidthAudioProcessor().

Do not implement StateManager class, full editor UI, or DSP engine classes. Do not edit CMakeLists.txt (a.1 sole owner).

Implement class DelayLineFrac in Source/DSP/DelayLineFrac.h + DelayLineFrac.cpp:
1. API: prepare(const juce::dsp::ProcessSpec&” or (double sampleRate, int maxBlockSize)), reset(), setDelayMs(float ms), processSample(float x) -> float (and optionally process(float* data, int n) in-place).
2. Fractional delay: convert ms→samples at the live sampleRate; read with 3rd-order (4-point) Lagrange (§4.3 coefficients) OR juce::dsp::DelayLine<float, juce::dsp::DelayLineInterpolationTypes::Lagrange3rd> equivalent. All neighbor reads must wrap the circular storage safely.
3. Capacity: preallocate in prepare for ceil(50ms * maxSampleRate) + Lagrange guard (≥4). Never allocate/resize outside prepare. maxSampleRate may be the prepare sampleRate if host max is unknown — size at least ceil(0.05 * sampleRate) + guard; document assumption.
4. D9 smoothing: smooth the *read distance* (not the write pointer) with juce::SmoothedValue (or equivalent linear ramp) reset to ≥50 ms ramp in prepare so automation does not pitch-glitch.
5. Clamp requested delay into [minDelaySamples, maxCapacity] (min ~1 sample or 1 ms equivalent). reset() clears buffer and smoothing state.
6. RT contract: no heap, locks, logs, or vectors resize on the audio path.

Do not implement PitchShifter, crossover, width, tests, or CMakeLists (b.5 sole CMakeLists owner). Do not wire into PluginProcessor.

goal:
Implement Source/DSP/PitchShifter only. One instance will later run at +detune and one at −detune.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md §§4.2 (dual-head granular end-to-end math), 4.3 (Lagrange), 4.9 (Studio L=2048 / Live L=512), §6 (detune smoothing feeds dv), §7–§8
- risk_notes: double drift accumulator; all four Lagrange neighbors wrapped mod L

Implement class PitchShifter in Source/DSP/PitchShifter.h + PitchShifter.cpp:
1. API: prepare(sampleRate, maxBlock), reset(), setLatencyModeStudioOrLive / setBufferLength(L), setDetuneCents(float deltaC), processSample(float x)->float (optional block process).
2. Circular buffer length L: always allocate Studio L_max=2048 + ≥4 Lagrange guard in prepare; Live uses the first 512 samples only (no realloc on mode switch).
3. Write pointer advances one sample per sample.
4. Two read heads A/B offset by L/2 as delays behind the write pointer. Drift accumulator tau is double (NOT float): advance by dv = 1 - pow(2.0, deltaC/1200.0) each sample; branchless wrap: if (tau >= L) tau -= L; if (tau < 0) tau += L.
5. Fractional read: 4-point cubic Lagrange (§4.3). Each of y_{-1}, y_0, y_1, y_2 is read with individual wrap mod L.
6. Raised-cosine (Hann) crossfade from head position so w_A + w_B == 1 exactly (unity gain, no ripple): w = 0.5 * (1 - cos(2π * tau_head / L)); heads L/2 apart.
7. detuneAmount path: accept smoothed cents (caller may smooth); setDetuneCents may also keep juce::SmoothedValue ~20 ms feeding dv so zipper cannot pitch-glitch.
8. Nominal delay for docs/engine: L/2 samples (not implemented as host PDC here).
9. RT: no heap/locks/logs outside prepare; O(1) per sample.

Do not implement DelayLineFrac/crossover/width, tests, or CMakeLists. Do not wire into PluginProcessor.

goal:
Implement Source/DSP/MonoSafetyCrossover only. Shared-LP centered lows + per-channel HP on shifted/delayed highs (§4.5–4.6).

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md §§4.5 (LR2 math, polarity D2), 4.6 (channel assembly roles), §6 (block-rate coeff), CMake SHREDWIDTH_XOVER_ORDER expectation from phase A
- risk_notes: HP polarity inverted; LR2/LR4 by compile option

Implement class MonoSafetyCrossover in Source/DSP/MonoSafetyCrossover.h + MonoSafetyCrossover.cpp:
1. API: prepare(spec/sampleRate), reset(), setCutoffHz(float fc), processBlock or process that can:
   - run the single shared LP on dry mono source x(n) once per sample
   - run HP on left shifted+delayed and right shifted+delayed independently
   Prefer clear methods such as processLowpass(float x)->float and processHighpassL/R(float x)->float, or a structured process(x, wetL, wetR, lpOut, hpLOut, hpROut).
2. LR2 default: two cascaded 1st-order Butterworth sections per band via juce::dsp::IIR::Filter (matched LP/HP). Coefficients from cutoff and sampleRate.
3. Build option: if SHREDWIDTH_XOVER_ORDER is defined as 4 (or == 4), use LR4 — two cascaded 2nd-order Butterworth per band (in-phase, 24 dB/oct). Default when undefined or 2 remains LR2. Use #if SHREDWIDTH_XOVER_ORDER == 4 (treat missing macro as 2).
4. Highpass polarity inverted internally so degenerate Mix=1, ΔC→0, τ→0 reconstruction is flat rather than notched (D2).
5. Coefficient recompute only when cutoff dirty flag set; apply at block start (setCutoffHz marks dirty; process applies once). Never recompute per-sample.
6. Shared LP is a single filter instance — bit-identical left/right lows by design when assembly later adds the same lp to both channels.
7. RT: fixed state, no heap outside prepare; ScopedNoDenormals is caller's job.

Do not implement other DSP classes, assembly engine, tests, or CMakeLists (b.5 may add compile definition wiring if missing — this task only consumes the macro).
